roadmap.title: Opening and Hivory Towers
roadmap.description: Play the Shipwreck Creek opening, learn the basics in Hivory Towers, earn your first Pagie, buy a move from Trowzer, unlock a Tonic at Vendi, expand the first world, and break the Capital B statue.

roadmap.title: Tribalstack Tropics
roadmap.description: Clear the first Grand Tome world: the minecart ride, Rextro's arcade, a Ghost Writer, a Pirate Treasure, your first transformation, and the world boss.

roadmap.title: Glitterglaze Glacier
roadmap.description: Pass Dr. Quack's first quiz, keep collecting Quills and Pagies, and defeat the second world boss.

roadmap.title: Moodymaze Marsh
roadmap.description: Expand a third Grand Tome world and defeat the third world boss.

roadmap.title: Capital Cashino
roadmap.description: Push your Quill and Pagie totals past 500 and 75, and defeat the fourth world boss.

roadmap.title: Galleon Galaxy
roadmap.description: Unlock and expand all five Grand Tome worlds, buy every Trowzer move, and defeat the fifth world boss.

roadmap.title: Capital B
roadmap.description: Clear the final Quackfire Quiz and defeat Capital B to finish the story.

roadmap.title: 100% cleanup
roadmap.description: Revisit Hivory Towers and every world to finish the remaining Pagies, Quills, Ghost Writers, Tonics, extenders, and Pirate Treasures.

steps.text: Play the opening until the game awards you a @item{Pagie}.
Keep completing Pagie challenges in @loc{Tribalstack Tropics} and @loc{Glitterglaze Glacier} until your total reaches 30.
Keep completing Pagie challenges and expanding worlds until your total reaches 75.

guide.context: The five Grand Tome worlds hold 25 Pagies each and Hivory Towers holds 20. A world cannot be completed on a first visit: expanding it and buying later Trowzer moves unlock the rest.

steps.text: Finish every Pagie challenge in the five worlds and Hivory Towers, expanding each world and returning once you have the needed moves.

guide.context: Trowzer is the snake merchant, and his moves are paid for with @item{Quills}, the currency scattered across every area.

steps.text: Find @npc{Trowzer} and buy any move from him with collected @item{Quills}.

guide.context: Most of Trowzer's moves are needed for progress, and the final move costs 100 Quills. Some players report this achievement failing to unlock when the last move is bought while Steam is offline, so stay online for the final purchase.

steps.text: Buy each move from @npc{Trowzer} as you gather @item{Quills}, and purchase the last move in @loc{Galleon Galaxy} while online.

achievements.summary: Unlock a Tonic at Vendi and equip it.

guide.context: Vendi is the vending machine in every world and in Hivory Towers, and only one Tonic can be active at a time.

steps.text: Collect 5 @item{Pagies} to unlock the @item{Wellard} Tonic.
Talk to @npc{Vendi} and equip @item{Wellard} from her Tonic list.

guide.context: Tonics are optional perks unlocked at Vendi, and only 15 of the 16 are needed.

steps.text: Talk to @npc{Vendi} to see every @item{Tonic} and its unlock requirement.
Unlock 15 by collecting @item{Pagies}, @item{Quills}, and @item{Ghost Writers}, beating Rextro high scores, defeating enemies, and finishing the story.

guide.context: Each Health Extender is a floating metallic butterfly that permanently adds one butterfly of health.

steps.text: Find the six metallic butterflies hidden one per area in Hivory Towers and each of the five Grand Tome worlds, then collect all six.

guide.context: Each Power Extender is a floating lightning bolt that permanently lengthens the power meter.

steps.text: Find the six lightning bolts hidden one per area in Hivory Towers and each of the five Grand Tome worlds, collecting all six.
steps.note: The Hivory Towers extender sits inside the nose of the golden Capital B statue.

achievements.description: Get transformed by Dr. Puzz for the first time
achievements.summary: Get your first transformation from Dr. Puzz.

guide.context: Each world hides one @item{Mollycool}, which @npc{Dr. Puzz} turns into that world's transformation.

steps.text: Find the @item{Mollycool} hidden in @loc{Tribalstack Tropics}.
Take the @item{Mollycool} to @npc{Dr. Puzz} and step into her ray to transform.

achievements.description: Complete one of Kartos’s minecart challenges
achievements.summary: Complete one of Kartos's minecart challenges.

guide.context: Kartos's minecart ride demands a set number of gems, and jumping, boosting, and shooting clear the track.

steps.text: Find @npc{Kartos} in @loc{Tribalstack Tropics}, start his minecart ride, and collect the gems he asks for.

achievements.description: Successfully complete one of Rextro’s arcade games
achievements.summary: Complete one of Rextro's arcade games.

guide.context: Each world hides an arcade token that unlocks Rextro's games for that world.

steps.text: Find the arcade token hidden in @loc{Tribalstack Tropics} and give it to @npc{Rextro} at his arcade machine.
Play the arcade game he opens and reach the end.

achievements.description: Get the high score in one of Rextro's Arcade Games
achievements.summary: Beat the high score on one of Rextro's arcade games.

guide.context: The recorded high score is low, so a second clear of the same game is normally enough.

steps.text: Replay the arcade game you finished and pass its high score.

guide.context: Each Grand Tome world hides five @item{Ghost Writers}, and each one is caught with a different ability or tactic.

steps.text: Catch any one of the @item{Ghost Writers} hidden in @loc{Tribalstack Tropics}.

achievements.description: Collect every Ghost Writer in the Grand Tome worlds
achievements.summary: Collect all 25 Ghost Writers in the five Grand Tome worlds.

guide.context: Each world hides five @item{Ghost Writers}, and each one is caught with a different ability or tactic.

steps.text: Collect all five @item{Ghost Writers} in @loc{Tribalstack Tropics}, @loc{Glitterglaze Glacier}, @loc{Moodymaze Marsh}, @loc{Capital Cashino}, and @loc{Galleon Galaxy}.

guide.context: Quills are the currency spent on Trowzer's moves, and certain moves are needed to finish the game.

steps.text: Pick up @item{Quills} across the hub and worlds until your total reaches 200.
Keep collecting @item{Quills} across the worlds until your total reaches 500.

guide.context: The five Grand Tome worlds hold 200 Quills each, and Hivory Towers holds 10 in Shipwreck Creek.

steps.text: Collect every @item{Quill} in the five worlds and the 10 in @loc{Shipwreck Creek}, using the @item{Hunter} Tonic to whistle for any you miss.

achievements.description: Unlock the first Grand Tome world
achievements.summary: Unlock the first Grand Tome world.

steps.text: In the first room of Hivory Towers, roll up the ramp and open the @loc{Tribalstack Tropics} book.

achievements.summary: Unlock all five Grand Tome worlds.

steps.text: Collect enough @item{Pagies} to open every Grand Tome book in Hivory Towers.

guide.context: Expanding a world costs Pagies and adds new areas, Pagie challenges, and Quills to it.

steps.text: Collect enough @item{Pagies}, then spend them to expand a Grand Tome world.

achievements.description: Complete one of Dr. Quack’s Quackfire Quizzes
achievements.summary: Finish one of Dr. Quack's Quackfire Quizzes.

guide.context: @npc{Dr. Quack} runs three Quackfire Quizzes across the game; three wrong answers restart a quiz, and a quick correct answer advances two spaces.

steps.text: Reach the first quiz on the route to @loc{Glitterglaze Glacier} and answer @npc{Dr. Quack}'s questions until the board is finished.

achievements.description: Defeat Capital B at the end of the game
achievements.summary: Defeat Capital B in the final boss fight.

guide.context: The final door needs 100 Pagies. The fight runs seven phases with no health butterflies, so collect the six Health and Power Extenders first.

steps.text: Open the final door with 100 @item{Pagies} and clear the last Quackfire Quiz.
Stun the bees with @mechanic{Super Echo}, spin @enemy{Capital B} to knock him down, then @mechanic{Buddy Slam} him.
Clear the enemy wave and hit @enemy{Capital B} with iceballs, then repeat the spin-and-slam pattern through the hive bomb phase.
In the last phase, fly high and bait his rockets back into him.

achievements.summary: Defeat the boss of Tribalstack Tropics, the first Grand Tome world.

guide.context: The route to the boss, a slope above a temple left of the spawn point, only appears after you expand Tribalstack Tropics.

steps.text: Expand the world, roll up the slope, and tail-whip the boss's teeth while dodging his fire.

achievements.summary: Defeat the boss of Glitterglaze Glacier, the second Grand Tome world.

guide.context: The Icymetric Palace only opens after you expand Glitterglaze Glacier.

steps.text: Go through the Icymetric Palace, light the torches behind the boss so the fire burns him, and dodge his snowballs.

achievements.summary: Defeat the boss of Moodymaze Marsh, the third Grand Tome world.

steps.text: Dodge the boss's swinging tentacle until he is stunned, then spin each eye on his body three times; his large eye appears on the left or right of the arena.

achievements.summary: Defeat the boss of Capital Cashino, the fourth Grand Tome world.

guide.context: This boss has three phases and no healing between them.

steps.text: In phase one, dodge or shoot the objects and damage the boss while his face is red.
In phase two, shoot the boss, then jump over him while boosting as he backs towards you; he also fakes out.
In phase three, jump the rockets in front of you so they hit the boss.

achievements.summary: Defeat the boss of Galleon Galaxy, the fifth Grand Tome world.

guide.context: Use this world's transformation to damage the boss.

steps.text: Transform into the pirate ship at @npc{Dr. Puzz}, then shoot the craters on the boss while dodging meteors.

achievements.summary: Buddy-slam the nose of the golden Capital B statue in Hivory Towers.

steps.text: In the first Hivory Towers room, fly up to the nose of the giant golden @npc{Capital B} statue and @mechanic{Buddy Slam} it.
steps.note: Breaking the nose also reveals a Power Extender.

achievements.description: Find any one of the pirate treasure items

guide.context: Each Grand Tome world hides one Pirate Treasure.

steps.text: Collect the Pirate Treasure sitting at the spawn point inside a lamp in @loc{Capital Cashino}.

achievements.description: Find any three of the pirate treasure items

guide.context: Each Grand Tome world hides one Pirate Treasure.

steps.text: Collect any three of the five Pirate Treasures hidden in the Grand Tome worlds.

achievements.description: Find all five of the pirate treasure items

guide.context: Each Grand Tome world hides one Pirate Treasure.

collectibles.name: Tribalstack Tropics treasure
collectibles.location: Below the Tribalstack Tropics boss arena, beside the Nimbus road.
collectibles.method: Reach the space under the airborne boss arena and collect the treasure.

collectibles.name: Glitterglaze Glacier treasure
collectibles.method: Enter the underwater cave and collect the treasure.

collectibles.name: Moodymaze Marsh treasure
collectibles.method: Climb onto the factory roof and collect the treasure.

collectibles.name: Capital Cashino treasure
collectibles.location: At the world spawn, inside a lamp.
collectibles.method: Check the lamp at the spawn point and collect the treasure.

collectibles.name: Galleon Galaxy treasure
collectibles.location: Atop a building within the Velocity Terminal, the giant meatball.
collectibles.method: Reach the building top inside the Velocity Terminal and collect the treasure.

steps.text: Collect enough @item{Pagies} and spend them to expand a third Grand Tome world.

achievements.description: Expand all five Grand Tome worlds
achievements.summary: Expand all five Grand Tome worlds.

steps.text: Collect enough @item{Pagies} and spend them to expand each of the five Grand Tome worlds.
